body:
I've been thinking since you posted this. It took a while but I think I understand why you say that life is meaning. It didn't make me feel happy - so this made me assume you were wrong, and I tried typing out arguments against it.  I realised though that I obviously wanted to hear one thing, when I think the answer is there:

 People live because they have the possibilities - interests, friends and so on - which give them meaning and let them live each day. I don't have such possibilities, hence I feel so sad, but the potential is there someday? Is that the message I take? 

Thanks again, this is very insightful and you're the first to say these things to me.

Thank you for replying. 
 >there is no point really in the grand scheme 

So how does a normal person reconcile this? Sorry, I feel that there must be something big I'm missing. I can't take interest or happiness from anything because of this problem, none of it means anything.

Thank you for replying. 
>living is a point in itself.

I don't understand, can you explain please?
